subject: Performance impact follow-up — credit framework and executive sync
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex@brightlane.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlane.ai <procurement@brightlane.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Major degradation: elevated latency/errors 2027-02-07 22:00 UTC onwards

Vivek —

We're seeing sustained elevated 5xx error rates and 3x median latency on calls to the Redwood hosted inference endpoint since ~22:00 UTC on 2027-02-07. This has impacted a subset of our production customers (approx. 18% of inference traffic) and caused several downstream job failures in our ingestion pipeline.

I've attached an incident timeline and a short CSV with request-level failure counts (incident-timeline-20270208.csv). Our procurement and legal teams are asking for:
- an executive review of what caused the degradation,
- a concrete remediation and retention plan for logs, and
- a proposed credit/compensation calculation per the SLA.

Please advise on next steps and whether an executive-level call is required — we need confirmation before our renewal conversation starts next week.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Head of Platform, BrightLane AI
Alex.Park@brightlane.ai

Attachment: incident-timeline-20270208.csv (CSV, 18KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Major degradation: elevated latency/errors 2027-02-07 22:00 UTC onwards

Alex — thank you for flagging and for the timeline attachment. I'm really sorry BrightLane hit this — we own it.

Immediate actions:
- I've spun up an incident response to preserve request and kernel-level logs; we'll provide a secured bundle for your audit team.
- Ops is running a preliminary root-cause analysis; initial signs point to an autoscaling path in the throughput plane failing under a small class of long-sequence requests.

Proposal for an executive escalation: a 30-minute sync tomorrow with our Head of Product (Marissa) and our Reliability lead (Rishi) to walk through findings and proposed credits. For speed, we'll draft a provisional credit framework now (not final): a one-time invoice credit equal to 15% of BrightLane's Jan 2027 bill for impacted throughput, plus a scope for a more precise post-mortem adjustment.

Please confirm whether you want the credit applied as an invoice adjustment or as a credit memo on your account. Also confirm if we have permission to include usage logs in the bundle we send to your security team.

- Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Draft credit framework + proposed logistics

Alex / team — looping in a couple of folks so we can move quickly on logistics.

Attached is a short proposal (SLA-credit-proposal-20270209.pdf) with two options:
A) Interim credit: a single invoice credit equaling 15% of Jan usage for the impacted window, issued within 7 business days.
B) Adjusted credit after post-mortem: provisional 15% now, with final reconciliation after the 30-day post-mortem (can increase/decrease based on scope).

Operational asks:
- Confirm preferred remediation instrument (credit vs invoice adjustment vs contract amendment).
- Permission to share redwood logs for audit (we'll redact PII).
- Confirmation that BrightLane will accept a DocuSign amendment for the credit terms if needed before renewal.

Linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/567890/BL-4892

If this is acceptable, Vivek / I will schedule the exec sync for tomorrow or Wed morning.

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SLA-credit-proposal-20270209.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
From: Alex Park <alex@brightlane.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlane.ai <procurement@brightlane.ai>, support@brightlane.ai <support@brightlane.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft credit framework + proposed logistics

Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the draft. We agree to Option B (provisional 15% now with final reconciliation after the post-mortem). A few asks before we lock dates:

1) Please apply the provisional credit as an invoice adjustment (not a one-off operational credit) and apply it to Feb invoices, ideally before our renewal negotiation begins.
2) We need a DocuSign amendment stating the provisional credit and post-mortem reconciliation window — procurement will not accept a verbal commitment.
3) Confirm you will retain raw request logs for 90 days for audit; we will share a list of the affected request-ids offline.

On the post-mortem: we expect a timeline and remediation plan within 30 calendar days, and would like a named owner from Redwood for each remediation bullet.

If you can confirm (1)-(3) today, we can make the exec sync focused on technical findings and remediation owners.

Regards,
Alex Park
Head of Platform, BrightLane AI

> On Tue, Feb 9, 2027 at 09:10 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Attached is a short proposal (SLA-credit-proposal-20270209.pdf) with two options:
> > A) Interim credit: a single invoice credit equaling 15% of Jan usage for the impacted window, issued within 7 business days.
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@brightlane.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft credit framework + proposed logistics

Alex — thanks, and confirmed. Short updates and next steps: 

- Credit instrument: we'll issue an invoice adjustment for the provisional 15% and apply it to the Feb 2027 billing cycle. Finance will push the adjustment within 5 business days; confirming we will also issue a credit memo for your records.
- DocuSign: legal has prepared an amendment template and I'll send the DocuSign link by EOD today (https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345-aml-amend).
- Logs & retention: ops will preserve the raw request logs and provide a secured bundle; retention will be 90 days, and we'll coordinate the exact transfer with your security team.
- Post-mortem & owners: Rishi will own the technical post-mortem; Neha will own remediation tracking and cross-team follow-up. Deliverables and dates below.

Planned timeline:
- Today (EOD): DocuSign amendment sent to procurement (Vivek)
- Feb 12: Executive sync (30 min) — attendees: Vivek, Marissa, Rishi, Alex + BrightLane execs
- Mar 11: Post-mortem report delivered (30-day window from Feb 8 incident) — includes root cause, remediation actions, verification plan
- Mar 25: Validation window close and final credit reconciliation completed

Please reply if any of the above needs to change; otherwise I’ll schedule the exec sync for Fri, Feb 12 at 09:00 PT and circulate the calendar invite.

Thanks again for working through this with us — we’ll do what it takes to make this right.

- Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-logs-20270208.zip (LOG bundle, redacted PII)
